notes.title: Our Kickstarter pre-launch page is live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone :)

This is our very first post on Steam for Micromega, and it’s a big milestone for us. We sincerely hope this message into the void finds some of you.

We’re a small, dedicated team working hard to bring this strange little world to life — and today, we’re excited to announce that our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/covengames/micromega]Kickstarter pre-launch page[/url] is now live!

The best way to support us right now is to follow the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/covengames/micromega]campaign[/url], so you don’t miss the launch day — and who knows, maybe you’ll be one of our very first backers!

This post also marks the beginning of this space we want to share with you — a way to say hello and let you know we’d love to chat, hear your thoughts, and talk more about the project.

So don’t forget to wishlist Micromega if you haven’t already — and stay tuned, we’ll keep you posted as the project grows!
